protocol: A/B/B/A, reversed case order in B2/A2, 800ms warmup and seven 200ms batches per stage. No simultaneous builds/tests. Arithmetic mean of two process medians.

stages.constructLower: Construct typed Dataset, call lowerDataset, consume ownKeyCount in checksum. Does not execute callback.
stages.updatePaint: Repeated full update(none), draw, native paint into recorder and completion/disposal. Includes no data mutation, lowering, widget rebuild, raster or vsync.

limits: Isolated construction microbenchmark; tiny absolute differences. No additional hot-path speedup established. The colors field uses diagnostic Color.toString in profile and is not a correctness oracle; actual values are checked by typed/raw twins and focused tests.
